title: Autonomous discovery of Cu-mediated propargyl-bromide activation
difficulty_reasons: The agent must formulate, generate, discriminate and validate a substantially open set of activation hypotheses and transition-state candidates while documenting search coverage and stopping.

paper.title: Expanding Ullmann Homocoupling to Cross-Coupling: Electrochemical Copper-Catalyzed Cross-Electrophile Coupling of Alkyl and Aryl Halides
paper.journal: Journal of the American Chemical Society

data.description: Self-contained XYZ catalyst precursor and explicit problem definition for Cu/L1/bromide plus propargyl bromide.

required_deliverables.description: Autonomous candidate search and validated result, or bounded-failure report, following submission_schema.json.
